semantics.clock: Sample j and k on each positive edge of clk; update Q using the state immediately before that edge.

truth_table.11: Q becomes bitwise complement of Qold

semantics.between_edges: Q retains its state regardless of input changes or falling clock edges.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified.
semantics.initialization: Initial Q is unspecified; no initialization is added. A set or clear clock edge establishes known state.
semantics.latency: State updates at the sampling positive edge, observable after the sequential update settles.

numeric.operation: Single-bit logical state selection and bitwise inversion; no arithmetic, rounding, saturation, or overflow applies.

verification.oracle: Independent testbench truth-table model using the previous expected Q.
verification.coverage: Establish both prior states with set/clear, then test all four j/k combinations for each prior state; exercise repeated toggles and a deterministic long sequence.
verification.timing: Check Q before rising edges, after rising-edge updates, on falling edges, and after input changes while clock is low.
verification.initial_state: Do not assert a power-up state; initialize the model through a specified clear edge.
verification.tools: Icarus Verilog v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, finite shell and testbench timeouts.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up Q and behavior for X/Z-valued j or k are unspecified; binary truth-table behavior is the verification requirement.
